values.note: ReserveAmerica, campsites up to 3 months ahead. The booking site says the campground 'is 100 percent reservable and accepts reservations April 1 - November 30 until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival'; the DNR page says 'The campground is 100% reservable and a reservation is required.' The --AWH note's 2-days-prior cutoff and relaxed FCFS cash option are not stated on either page.

41 electric sites (39 at 20/30/50 amp, 2 at 50 amp). Only the campground host's site 24 lists water and sewer.

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 52 campsites: 41 electric RV sites, 1 non-electric RV site, 9 tent-only sites, plus the host site and 3 shelters. Listed equipment lengths for RV sites 20-70 ft (most 55-60 ft); all listed driveways back-in.

values.note: The DNR page announces 'the reopening of the campground' with a 2025 promo code; ReserveAmerica shows it open through November 30 2026.

summary: Confirmed ReserveAmerica, 100% reservable, 3-month window (now on the entry), 50-amp electric, showers and dump. Added season Apr 1 - Nov 30 per RA (DNR says closed in November; both in the note), max rig 70 ft, status open after the campground's reopening. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Count, cutoff and FCFS left alone because the --AWH note states them (see flags). Not stated: min stay for this campground, water/sewer at public sites, pull-throughs.
flags: Site count: the --AWH note (and derived sites.count 76) says '76 sites, 61 electric'; ReserveAmerica now lists 52 campsites (41 electric, 1 non-electric RV, 9 tent, plus host site 24). The campground was recently closed and reopened (DNR page), so the layout may have changed. Not overwritten because it is AWH note text.

Cutoff: the --AWH note says reservable 'until 2-days prior to arrival' and describes a relaxed FCFS cash option; ReserveAmerica now says reservations are accepted 'until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival' and same-day booking is open ('Reservations can be made for today'), and DNR says 'a reservation is required'. reserve_until and fcfs (after_cutoff) were left as they are; AWH should decide whether to update the note.
